_doc: THE AGENTS declaration (Fsync > Agents). One entry per on-device agent; AgentsDecl parses it and AgentsScreen draws one dense KitStoreRow per entry. `id` is the only thing the code dispatches on. Names and captions here, not in Kotlin; sizes come from the ui-kit KitStoreRow ramp.

agents.name: Screenshot OCR
agents.summary: Reads every screenshot on the phone, on-device, and writes <name>.md and <name>.json beside it.
